display.purpose: App wordmark and hero-scale moments only; not used for ordinary headings.

headline.purpose: h1 screen titles, rendered in Fredoka semibold.

title.purpose: h2/h3 section and card-group headings, Fredoka semibold.

body.purpose: All running text, row labels and values, Inter regular.

label.purpose: Form labels, hints, errors, row values, Inter semibold at small sizes.

shadows.name: floating-panel
shadows.purpose: Menu panel and actively-dragged reorder row only; every resting surface is flat.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Default state transition for buttons, toggles and checks.

motion.name: page-transition
motion.purpose: Router view-transition between screens; a fade rather than a directional slide since screens are unrelated content.

breakpoints.name: container-row
breakpoints.purpose: Container query threshold below which a row stacks its label/value/chevron.

breakpoints.name: container-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Container query threshold below which decoration (icon size, padding) drops to fixed px while text keeps scaling.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: var(--spacing-touch); min-width: var(--spacing-touch); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary-foreground); border: none; transition: filter 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.9); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis text-only button, e.g. a secondary sheet action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: var(--spacing-touch); min-width: var(--spacing-touch); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 600; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground); border: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: var(--color-muted); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-muted); } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The field shell around a labelled text input; border thickens on focus without reflowing.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-input-background); padding: 8px 16px; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-width: 4px; border-color: var(--color-ring); padding: 6px 14px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; outline: none; font-size: 16px; color: var(--color-foreground); }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Bottom tab bar; active destination marked by bold label plus an accent indicator bar, never color alone.
components.css: .ds-tab-bar { background: var(--color-nav-bg); color: var(--color-rebel-text); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-tab-list { display: flex; } .ds-tab { min-height: var(--spacing-touch); flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; font-size: 14px; background: none; border: none; color: inherit; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tab-active { font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; } .ds-tab-indicator { display: none; background: var(--color-accent); height: 4px; width: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-tab-active .ds-tab-indicator { display: block; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Calendar Pill
components.description: A calendar's colour identity as a rounded chip: coloured border over a tinted background, arbitrary per-instance colour.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid var(--pill-color, var(--color-border)); padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-foreground); background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pill-color, var(--color-border)) 15%, var(--color-card)); }

components.name: Grouped List Row
components.description: A row inside a grouped list surface; the surface clips first/last row corners and divides rows with a hairline.
components.css: .ds-list { background: var(--color-card); color: var(--color-card-foreground); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { min-height: var(--spacing-row); width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); text-align: left; } .ds-row-label { min-width: 0; flex: 1; font-size: 16px; } .ds-row-value { color: var(--color-muted-foreground); min-width: 0; font-size: 14px; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: -2px; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-row:hover { filter: brightness(0.98); } } .ds-row:active { filter: brightness(0.97); }

components.name: Checklist Check
components.description: The round checkbox used for the Nicht vergessen checklist; native input reskinned, tick drawn from rotated borders.
components.css: .ds-check { appearance: none; display: grid; place-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-card); width: 1.35em; height: 1.35em; } .ds-check:checked { background: var(--color-primary); border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-check:checked::after { content: ''; width: 0.5em; height: 0.25em; border-left: 2px solid var(--color-primary-foreground); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-primary-foreground); transform: translateY(-0.06em) rotate(-45deg); } .ds-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: The Print Kalender, Rebuilt as Touch
narrative.overview:
The app is a digital continuation of an existing physical Rebell*innen Kalender, and the visual system reads that way: a chunky, rounded, poster-like display face (Fredoka) over a plain, legible body face (Inter), warm-but-bold color blocks, and the dotted notebook-grid background (.dotted-bg) lifted directly from the print design. Nothing in the system is decorative for its own sake - every primitive exists because a real screen (Today, appointments, Nicht vergessen, Anlaufstellen) needed it, and the component set stays deliberately small: buttons, cards/rows, fields, choices, pills, checks, toggles, sheets, a tab bar, a dropdown menu, a reorderable list.

The system is four swappable palettes (amazone default, warm/Sonnenuntergang, nacht/Mitternacht, lila/Lavendel) over one shared shape, type and spacing language - recoloring the app is a data-theme attribute swap, never a second set of components. Everything is built for a thumb on glass: no bare hover: anywhere in the codebase, min-h-touch (48px) on every interactive target, 16px-minimum form text, and a text-size ladder (small 14px through xxlarge 32px) that reflows components rather than clipping them - container queries, not media queries, drive that reflow because only a container query reacts to root-font-size growth.
keyCharacteristics: Chunky rounded display type (Fredoka) paired with a plain, highly legible UI/body face (Inter)
Four complete, swappable color themes sharing one token structure, not one static palette

Native-control-first: checkboxes, radios and switches are real <input>s reskinned with accent-color/appearance: none, not custom widgets, so forced-colors mode and screen readers get the platform's own behavior for free
A print-calendar motif (the dotted notebook grid) as the app's one recurring decorative texture
No shadows as a default idiom; depth comes from flat color-block layering, with shadow-lg reserved for genuinely floating surfaces (menu panel, dragged row)

rules.name: The No Color-Only Signal Rule
rules.body: In every theme, danger is deliberately much darker than primary - on amazone specifically, the brand primary is itself red, which would collide with the conventional "danger" red if the two weren't kept clearly apart. Every destructive action pairs its color with an explicit verb, an icon, and a confirmation step - never color alone.

rules.name: The Theme-Complete Rule
rules.body: A color is never hard-coded outside theme.css. Adding a fifth theme means adding one [data-theme='…'] block there (plus registering its id in the settings interactor) - no other file, and no TypeScript, holds a color value.

rules.name: The Hyphenate-and-Wrap Rule
rules.body: German compounds are long. body sets hyphens: auto (with lang="de" on <html>) plus overflow-wrap: anywhere as a fallback, and no label anywhere uses whitespace-nowrap.

rules.name: The Absolute-Scale Rule
rules.body: The in-app text-size setting replaces the OS text-scale rather than multiplying it, and deliberately stops at 2x, Apple's own Larger-Text floor.

rules.name: The Flat-Unless-Floating Rule
rules.body: A shadow is reserved for an element that has actually left the page's normal layer (an open menu, a row mid-drag). Every resting surface stays flat.

dos: Do keep every color value inside theme.css's per-theme blocks; a theme is complete or it doesn't exist (The Theme-Complete Rule).
Do gate hover styles behind hoverable: and use active: for the state that actually matters on a touch screen.
Do use container queries (18rem/13rem thresholds), not media queries, for any layout rule that must react to the in-app text-size setting.
Do reserve shadow-lg for content that has actually left the page's normal stacking layer (an open menu, a dragged row) - not for ordinary resting cards or fields.
Do pair danger with an explicit verb, icon and confirmation step; never let color alone carry a destructive action.
Do keep a native <input type="checkbox">/radio under any reskinned control (check, toggle, choice) so forced-colors mode, Space/Enter and screen-reader semantics keep working.
donts: Don't write a bare hover: utility anywhere - it sticks after a tap on touch and never clears.
Don't give an interactive element a fixed h-*/w-*; use min-h-touch/min-w-touch so a wrapped label at a large text size never clips.
Don't introduce a shadow on a resting surface (card, row, field, sheet panel) - depth there comes from the flat card/background color pairing, never a drop shadow.
Don't add a fifth radius value outside the sm/md/lg/xl scale derived from --rk-radius.
